summary.zh: 首个公开测试版可以在本地网页量盘、设计、刻录，再把手机拍的照片传回电脑核对。现在刻前会直接告诉你盘哪里不合适，刻后看不见图有检查单，几何测量漏了一段也能接着量。彩色刻图只在 RITEK DVD-R（RITEKF1）配 GH70N 上验证过。灯下视图的颜色只供预览。擦除只在模拟光驱上测过。
summary.en: The first public alpha lets you measure, design and burn in a local web app, then send a phone photo back to check the result. It explains disc problems before you burn, gives you a checklist if the picture is hard to see and lets you fill gaps in a measurement. Colour burning has only been verified on RITEK DVD-R (RITEKF1) with a GH70N. Colours in the lamp view are previews. Erasing has only been tested on simulated drives.

title.zh: 刻前先查盘，刻完找不到图也能查
title.en: Check the disc before burning and find out why a picture is missing

story.zh: 作品和测量盘在写入前都会检查托盘、盘种、容量和批次。哪里不对、下一步怎么办，直接写在刻录页上。刻完点「看不到图？」可以查盘上写了什么。有原镜像或可用的刻录记录时，还能核对抽样回读。检查单也会提示怎么打光、拿盘。
story.en: Before writing a project or a measurement disc, Disc Probe checks the tray, disc type, capacity and batch. The burn page shows what went wrong and what to do next. After burning, “Can’t see the picture?” checks what was written and can compare sampled sectors when the original image or a matching burn record is available. The checklist also shows how to light and hold the disc.

title.zh: 漏测的地方接着量，照片也能手动对准
title.en: Fill gaps in a measurement and align a photo by hand

story.zh: 几何测量结果会标出哪些半径量过、哪里还空着。点「补测空档」可以接着量缺的那一段。拍照页也能手动对齐：拖动条纹和转角，和照片上的标靶对一对，再保存给出图和预设使用。
story.en: The geometry results show which radii were measured and where the gaps are. Fill the gaps by resuming the measurement from its saved result. On the photo page, you can shift and rotate the overlay to match the target, then save your alignment for image generation and presets.

title.zh: 新建作品可以先画，再选批次
title.en: Start designing before choosing a batch

story.zh: 新作品页会说清光驱里是空白盘、已经刻过的盘，还是没有盘。点「稍后再定」可以先画，生成刻录镜像前再选批次。社区预设可以参考，用到手上这批盘前还要自己确认。预设页跟着界面切换中英文。工作台四角重新调整了轻重，浮起的按钮和面板的影子朝同一个方向。
story.en: The New work page tells you whether the drive holds a blank disc, a written disc or no disc. Select “Choose later” to start designing and pick a batch before making the burn image. Community presets are a starting point, so check them against your batch. The preset page follows the app’s language. The four corners have been rebalanced, with raised controls and panels sharing the same shadow direction.

pitch.zh: 全新上市！把整张桌子换成牛皮纸色，铜色按钮更亮一点。耐看、耐脏、不伤眼。
pitch.en: New! The whole desk in kraft brown, the copper buttons a shade brighter. Easy on the eyes, hides the coffee rings.

pitch.zh: 熬夜刻盘的你值得拥有！深蓝底、白线条，像一张工程图。附赠：不晃眼的琥珀色。
pitch.en: For the late-night burner! Deep blue, white lines, like an engineering drawing. Bonus: an amber that won't glare.

note.zh: 极坐标排布，越往外越疏
最省事的背景，刻错也看得出来
note.en: The simplest background; a wrong preset shows at once

caption.zh: 一张 DVD-R 上刻图又存了 1.38 GB 数据，读回来没有错。颜色随角度变。
caption.en: A picture plus 1.38 GB of data on one DVD-R, read back without an error. The colour changes with the angle.
The whole scroll in two rings.

caption.zh: 先用 geo，再在 DiscImageStudio 里精修。经作者同意刊登。
caption.en: geo first, then fine calibration in DiscImageStudio. Printed with the author's permission.

jokes.zh: 问：光盘为什么从不迷路？答：它一直沿着轨道走。
jokes.en: Why does a disc never get lost? It always stays on track.

jokes.zh: 我的光驱很有礼貌：每次弹出来都先打个招呼——咔哒。
jokes.en: My drive is very polite: every time it pops out, it says click first.

jokes.zh: CD 问 DVD：你怎么装下那么多东西？DVD：轨距收紧一点就好。
jokes.en: CD asked DVD how it holds so much. DVD: just tighten your track pitch.

jokes.zh: 这台传真机只收不发。它说：我是个好听众。
jokes.en: This fax only receives. It says it is a good listener.

jokes.zh: 光驱说它今天一张盘也没读。托盘说，你倒是先让我关上啊。
jokes.en: The drive said it hadn’t read a single disc all day. The tray said you could start by closing me.

title.en: Colour that holds in your hand

note.zh: 继续用试刻筛选纹理，看看哪些颜色斜着拿也能看清。
note.en: Keep testing textures on disc to see which colours stay visible when you tilt it.

note.zh: 包裹拆开就能换上，不喜欢再换回来。
note.en: Open the parcel and wear it; switch back if you don't like it.

note.zh: 还是这张桌子，只是能转一转。
note.en: The same desk, only you can turn it.
